atoms.text: Scientists also believe that dinosaurs became extinct after a meteor collision. The meteor was massive, so it caused a huge tidal wave when it hit the Earth, destroying life in coastal areas.

The meteor polluted the atmosphere with dust and gas, darkening the sky. This resulted in a winter that lasted for years, during which plants died and many animals were left with nothing to eat. Most animals became extinct as a result.
